_note: Per-hunter rules for the catwalk decks over level 0 (hunters/decks.rs). A hunter row overrides single keys of default. can_climb: the hunter walks to a catwalk ladder and climbs it, up to a deck and back down. can_jump_down: the hunter may jump off a deck to chase or investigate a target on the floor below (never while wandering or searching; it takes the ladder then). landing_stun_seconds (0 to 10): stun after a landing. fall_damage: only "none" exists, a landing never hurts a hunter. The ground-only gimmick hunters (nyxie, solyth, ysolde, void_blue, void_green) teleport or lunge on the floor and stay off decks until their gimmicks are deck-aware. The edge costs and the jump arc are in flights.json.
